arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Andre stated the sides that brought the case filed administrative grievances with the Michigan Department of Corrections.
Ms. Olivieri stated Congress enacted the Prison Litigation Reform Act to reduce the flood of prisoner litigation.
Justice Breyer noted that many prisoner claims are hard to decipher and often lack substance.
Justice Breyer asked if the solution requires amending the Federal Rules of Civil Procedure.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: This dispute determines whether federal courts must screen prisoner lawsuits for internal complaint use. It affects the volume of cases courts must process. It impacts how quickly prisoners can seek legal remedies.
